item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. You've got a packed day of check-ins, movement, and wind-down routines, which means it's easy to run on empty without noticing. Busy days burn through water faster than you think. Set a simple marker: before your midday walk, drink a full glass of water — no excuses. Keep a bottle within reach through the evening stretch too. Action: drink water now, before your next commitment starts.
